name: HH regime-switch 12 — crypto momentum with an equity-trend (SPX/NDX) risk-off kill-switch (daily)
rationale: MECHANISM (defensive, distinct from variant 11: the kill-switch is the EQUITY-INDEX TREND, not VIX — it gates crypto momentum on both spx_index and ndx_index being in uptrends, a slower structural risk-on read than VIX's fast fear gauge): the argument is that crypto's beta to risk assets means momentum whipsaws when the broad equity tape is rolling over; requiring SPX and NDX to be above their own trend (index level above a fitted floor relative to recent range is proxied by requiring both indices themselves to be rising via ret-style comparison) keeps momentum on only in a confirmed risk-on structural regime. Here we require spx_index and ndx_index both above fitted regime floors AND adx trend AND ret_Nd positive. Abstention-based, so a LOW bar. Exit: ADX collapse or NDX breaking down (risk-off), or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: gated vs ungated momentum on the same asset/period — the equity-trend veto must raise net-of-fee return AND cut maxDD together; if it just reduces trade count for equal Sharpe, it is cosmetic. Also, if spx_index and ndx_index veto identically (perfectly collinear), one of them is redundant — drop it. Expect death by the same abstention argument as 11.
catalyst: crypto trend taken only while the equity risk complex is structurally risk-on
